# Crafter's Journal

A World of Warcraft: Forever addon to **level every profession the cheapest way** and keep track of your **recipe collection**.

- Cheapest route from your current skill to the cap, step by step, with real Auction House prices.
- Trainers by rank, with a waypoint to the nearest one.
- Every recipe of each profession: which you know, which you can learn now, and where to get the rest.
- English and Spanish.
- AH prices come from Auctionator's full scan: install Auctionator to scan (the Scan button starts its scan and the addon reads it).

Download it from CurseForge (link coming soon).

## Development

- The addon code is this folder. In WoW, `Interface\AddOns\CraftersJournal` can be a directory junction to it.
- Data is generated from the WoW Forever client tables (wago.tools), CMaNGOS and QuestieDB: `python tools/build_data.py` regenerates `Data/` and runs the tests.
- `python tools/run_tests.py` runs every test and exits non-zero if any fails (Python 3 + `lupa`, no WoW needed). See `docs/TESTS.md` (in Spanish).
- `python tools/package.py` builds the release zip in `dist/` (the same as the CurseForge packager: no `tools/` or `docs/`).
- Releases are published by `.github/workflows/release.yml` when a `v*` tag is pushed.
- Roadmap: `docs/PLAN.md` (in Spanish).

# Crafter's Journal

## 0.71.1

- **The Skyborne Auction House in Valanaar works again.** Its auctioneer has no faction, so the addon took it for the neutral Auction House: it didn't scan, hid its buttons and said it doesn't work there yet, although that Auction House is your faction's. Now only Booty Bay, Gadgetzan and Everlook count as neutral, and at Skyborne the addon scans and works like at any of your faction's Auction Houses.
- **Recipe scrolls with their real name.** The route asked you to buy "Recipe: Draught of Detect Lesser Invisibility", which doesn't exist: in Forever that scroll is "Recipe: Elixir of Detect Lesser Invisibility". About 40 recipes have a scroll with a different name (the Transmutes, Elixir of Giants, Carrie's Cookbook, Enchanted Sigil: Innovation...). Now the route, its tooltips and Merchant's Favor use the scroll's real name, say which recipe it teaches when the names differ, and a scroll bought on the AH counts for the route even under that other name.
- **Choose how long your auctions last.** New option in /cj options, Auction House: "Auction duration". Automatic (as before: 24 h for what sells well, 8 h for the doubtful), or always 2 h, 8 h or 24 h. It applies to the sell window, the Inventory and the route, and the deposit and whether the AH is worth it are calculated with it. (CurseForge)
- **Works with newer versions of Shortest Path Forever.** The addon only accepted version 1 of its API, so with a newer Shortest Path Forever it fell back to TomTom or the game's waypoint. Now any version works. (Thanks, kyle!)

## 0.71.0

- **Discolored Healing Potions: the route tells you about the quest first.** Odd Child (Alliance, in the Moonbrook barn in Westfall) and Apothecary Renferrel (Horde, in Silverpine Forest) only teach the six Discolored Healing Potions after you do their quest, and the route sent you to train them without a word: one player crossed the world from Orgrimmar to find Renferrel wouldn't teach them. Now the "Train" row of those potions says which quest comes first ("First: quest "My First Real Potion"", or "a quest from Apothecary Renferrel" while the Horde quest isn't known) and clicking it takes you to whoever gives it. The recipe collection says the same and no longer lists them as "You can learn it now". Untick the route's quest icon and the route and Make Money leave them out until you've done the quest. Once you've done it, learned one of them or seen them on the trainer's list, they're normal trainer recipes again. Opening a trainer before the quest no longer makes the addon think Forever removed them. (Discord)
- **Major Discolored Healing Potion: the route waits until 270.** At 260 the route sent you to learn it, but the trainer doesn't teach it until Alchemy 270. (Discord)
- **How to remove a recipe from the route.** If you don't want to go for a recipe, the X on its row in the route removes it and the route picks another. Now the tooltip of every "Train" or "Get recipe" row says so, and the assistant's step tells you to open the route in the window to find that X. (Discord)
- **Listing on the AH keeps the copper.** The sell window next to the Auction House said "You list 2 × 8s 99c", but clicking it asked to list them at 8s and listed them at 8s, so you lost the 99c on each one. The addon rounded every listing down to whole silver. Now the sell window, the Inventory tab and the route list at the exact price they show, copper included. (Discord)
- **A failed scan no longer leaves the addon stuck.** If something went wrong while reading the auctions, the scan stayed "busy" for good: you couldn't scan again or list anything until you reloaded. Now the scan is cancelled with a message and you can scan again as soon as the button allows it.
- **Another addon's scan right after yours no longer restarts the countdown.** After a /reload just after scanning, Auctionator's automatic scan when you opened the AH left the Scan button on "scanning" for 2 minutes and restarted the 15-minute countdown, although the server ignores scans that soon. Now the addon doesn't wait for it and the countdown stays as it was.
- **The AH purchase message only shows up for what you need.** After buying anything on the Auction House, the chat said it "already counts for the route", even with no route or shopping list (a Stonescale Eel, for example). Now it only shows up for items your Shopping list or a started route asks for.
- **Russian: no more squares between words.** The Russian font has no "·" and showed a square wherever the addon separates two things in a line. With the Russian client, or with the addon in Russian, the separator is now " - ".
- **Prices no longer split across lines.** The Russian client puts a space between a number and its coin, so a long line could leave a coin alone at the start of the next one. Each number now stays next to its coin.
- **More room for longer texts.** Buttons, column headers, the Collection filter, "Last scan", the windows next to the vendor and the AH and the mini Shopping list are wider, so texts in other languages fit. Rows and icons are a bit larger, page subtitles sit right under the title, and the Shopping list status can use two lines.

## 0.70.0

- **The Shopping list includes the recipe scrolls you buy on the AH.** With "Whole route", the Shopping list had all the materials but no recipes: after buying everything, the route sent you back to the Auction House for each pattern, one step at a time. Now a started route's list also asks for one of each recipe scroll the route still has to learn when the AH is its best source: with "Whole route", those of every remaining step; stage by stage, those of the stage you're in. The AH button of the list buys them like any material, and the route's "Get recipe" row turns into "Recipe bought" by itself. A scroll in your bags or still in the mail counts as bought, and once you learn the recipe it's no longer asked for. Recipes from quests, vendors or Merchant's Favor stay out of the list: their "Get recipe" row still takes you there. The Materials view shows the same scrolls, also before you start the route, the vendor window doesn't offer a scroll the route buys on the AH, and the Inventory keeps a scroll you carry for a later step instead of suggesting you sell it.
- **The addon tells you when Auctionator's Scan button won't update it.** By default, Auctionator's Scan button (and its automatic scan when you open the AH) does a quick summary scan that only brings the lowest price of each item, and Crafter's Journal needs the full one. Scanning with Auctionator left "Last scan" unchanged without saying why. Now the chat says so the first time in each session, and the tooltip of the Scan buttons explains it: use Crafter's Journal's Scan button, or turn on "Use alternate slower scan mode by default" in Auctionator's options. If you hid the Scan buttons in the options, they're only hidden while Auctionator does full scans: otherwise they show greyed out, with what you need to turn on. The same goes without Auctionator installed.
- **The route assistant no longer errors in combat or dungeons.** There the game hides some values from addons, such as your speed, which way you're facing or your position, and the assistant tried to use them anyway: it stopped updating and logged "attempt to perform numeric conversion on a secret number value" in /cj errors. It now treats a hidden value as unknown: the arrow says there's no position here, and the travel time uses your running speed. If the assistant ever fails again, /cj errors keeps where it happened.
- **Closing the AH right after an Auctionator scan now tells you the prices weren't saved.** When Auctionator's own Scan button (or its automatic scan) finished, Crafter's Journal could still be reading those auctions. Closing the Auction House then cancelled the reading without a word, and "Last scan" kept showing the time of the previous scan, as if the new one had been lost. Now the chat says the prices weren't saved and to keep the AH open until the addon finishes, and "Last scan" shows "Cancelled". Nothing changes if the server hadn't answered yet.

## 0.69.1

- **AH purchases you've already used no longer count as "you have".** What you buy on the Auction House counts right away, even while it's still in your mailbox, and stops counting once it reaches your bags. But the addon only checked while one of its windows was showing: if you took your purchase out of the mailbox and used it with the addon closed, it never saw it arrive and kept counting it for up to 2 hours. The Shopping list said "you have 70 of 70" Mithril Bars with none in your bags, and the route counted 140 Mithril Ore that had already been smelted, adding more with every purchase. The addon now checks every time your bags change, even when it's closed. The Shopping list also says how much of what you have is still in the mail ("you have 70 of 70 (70 in the mail)").

## 0.69.0

- **New route icon: Green recipes.** On green recipes not every craft gives a point, so the last few points can cost much more than expected. Untick the new dice icon (next to "Fewer crafts") and the route uses an orange or yellow recipe whenever there is one, even if it costs a bit more; green only at levels where there's nothing else (Tailoring 285-300, First Aid 210-270). "Fewer crafts" already avoided some greens, but at higher levels it barely changed anything. In our tests, turning greens off removed every avoidable green point and made most 1-300 routes 1-11% more expensive. Each profession keeps its own setting. Hover the icon to see how many green points the route you're looking at has: many routes already have few or none (Leatherworking 1-150 had just one), and then turning greens off barely changes them. After you switch it, the tooltip also says how much more (or less) the route costs without greens. Avoiding greens has no price limit, and sometimes it's a lot: with our prices, Tailoring 1-300 went from about 250 to 950 gold, because the last 5 points used Robe of the Archmage. The route icons are slightly smaller so the new one fits. (CurseForge)
- **Hide our Scan buttons if Auctionator's is enough.** If you already scan with Auctionator's Scan button, the Scan button in the addon's header and the "Crafter's Journal: Scan" button above the Auction House can be one too many. Turn off "Crafter's Journal scan buttons" in /cj options, Auction House, to hide both (they're still shown by default). Scanning works exactly the same: the addon reads every Auctionator full scan (its Scan button or its automatic scan when you open the AH), so your prices keep updating, and /cj scan still starts one. Open the addon with /cj or the minimap button. The Shopping list button moves into the corner the AH button leaves. If you had turned off the button above the AH, the header one is hidden too now. (CurseForge)
- **"Train" takes you to a trainer who has the recipe.** Forever lowered the skill needed for many trainer recipes, but they're still taught by the same trainers as before. The route's arrow picked a trainer by the new skill and sometimes sent you to one who doesn't have the recipe: for Soft-soled Linen Boots (now 55) it pointed to Lawrence Schneider in Stormwind, but it's Sellandus who teaches it. The "Train" row now takes you to the nearest trainer who actually teaches it. This fixes 52 recipes in Tailoring, Leatherworking, Blacksmithing and Alchemy, such as Woolen Bag, Fine Leather Belt, Runed Copper Bracers and Greater Mana Potion. Routes and their costs don't change. (Discord)
- **The Shopping list counts what you've already converted.** An Enchanting route asked to convert 36 Greater Magic Essence into 108 Lesser Magic Essence, and after converting them the Shopping list still asked for all 45 Greater, even though Materials and the assistant already counted the Lesser ones. Now a started route's Shopping list counts them the same way: the 108 Lesser count as 36 of the 45 Greater and the list asks for 9. The row says how many you have, including what you converted. Lists saved by hand (Make Money, Calculator) are unchanged. (Discord)
- **Fix a purchase or sale in Investments.** Typed the wrong quantity or price? In an item's detail, click a purchase or sale to change its quantity or price, with the same preview as when you add one (your average before and after, or what you get net). It keeps its date and stays a purchase or a sale. If the change would leave a later sale with more units than you had, it tells you and doesn't save it. Deleting one with its X now asks first (turn that off in /cj options, Investments), and the chat says what was added, fixed or deleted.
- **Hide Investments list columns.** In /cj options, Investments, click a column (You have, Your average, Invested, Price, Since your average, If sold) to hide it from the list view, like hiding tabs; click it again to bring it back. The other columns move to the right and the item name gets the space. If the list was sorted by a column you hide, it's sorted by name until you show it again. The card view doesn't change.
- **A clear notice at the neutral Auction House.**

## 0.68.0

- **Much less memory after an AH scan.** Reading a full AH scan left a lot of temporary data behind, and since all addons share one Lua memory, WoW's garbage collector took minutes to clean it up: in the meantime your addon list showed Crafter's Journal at 100 MB or more. A scan now creates less than half of that (in our tests, 34 MB instead of 75 MB for 150,000 auctions), with exactly the same prices, market alerts and competition. The addon keeps only the auctions it actually compares later (the cheapest ones of each item, up to 10% above the lowest price) instead of every auction, and builds what it saves with much less waste. Right after a scan, it also helps the garbage collector in small steps for a few seconds (never in combat), so the number goes back down in seconds instead of minutes. (CurseForge)
- **Less memory while the window is closed.** After the window has been closed for a minute, the addon lets go of what Make Money, Merchant's Favor and Investments keep in memory, which can be over 10 MB once you've opened Make Money. Reopening those tabs works them out again in a moment, with the same results. Their lists also let go of what they last showed, which kept those results in memory even after they were released. Your started route and the assistant are kept as they are. WoW doesn't let an addon unload itself, so the addon can't go down to zero, but it now stays much lighter when you're not using it. (CurseForge)
- **Short of something an earlier step made? The route has you craft it again.** Some routes craft a material in one step and use it in a later one: Leatherworking cures Medium Hides to level and then uses those Cured Medium Hides for Hillman's Shoulders. With some luck in the first step you level with fewer crafts than expected and end up with fewer than the route counted on. The route then asked you to buy the missing ones ready-made on the AH, with no Medium Hide or Salt to make them. Now it asks for the materials (5 Medium Hide and 5 Salt) and adds a "Craft 5× Cured Medium Hide" row before the step that uses them. (CurseForge)

Now a started route's Shopping list counts them the same way: the 108 Lesser count as 36 of the 45 Greater and the list asks for 9. The row says how many you have, including what you converted. Lists saved by hand (Make Money, Calculator) are unchanged. (Discord)
- **Fix a purchase or sale in Investments.** Typed the wrong quantity or price? In an item's detail, click a purchase or sale to change its quantity or price, with the same preview as when you add one (your average before and after, or what you get net). It keeps its date and stays a purchase or a sale. If the change would leave a later sale with more units than you had, it tells you and doesn't save it. Deleting one with its X now asks first (turn that off in /cj options, Investments), and the chat says what was added, fixed or deleted.
- **Hide Investments list columns.** In /cj options, Investments, click a column (You have, Your average, Invested, Price, Since your average, If sold) to hide it from the list view, like hiding tabs; click it again to bring it back. The other columns move to the right and the item name gets the space. If the list was sorted by a column you hide, it's sorted by name until you show it again. The card view doesn't change.
- **A clear notice at the neutral Auction House.** Crafter's Journal doesn't work at the neutral Auction House (Booty Bay, Gadgetzan, Everlook) yet, and the only hint was a chat line that was easy to miss. Opening it now shows a window saying so, once per session. Tick "Don't show this notice again" to turn it off, and turn it back on in /cj options, Auction House.

## 0.68.0

- **Much less memory after an AH scan.** Reading a full AH scan left a lot of temporary data behind, and since all addons share one Lua memory, WoW's garbage collector took minutes to clean it up: in the meantime your addon list showed Crafter's Journal at 100 MB or more. A scan now creates less than half of that (in our tests, 34 MB instead of 75 MB for 150,000 auctions), with exactly the same prices, market alerts and competition. The addon keeps only the auctions it actually compares later (the cheapest ones of each item, up to 10% above the lowest price) instead of every auction, and builds what it saves with much less waste. Right after a scan, it also helps the garbage collector in small steps for a few seconds (never in combat), so the number goes back down in seconds instead of minutes. (CurseForge)
- **Less memory while the window is closed.** After the window has been closed for a minute, the addon lets go of what Make Money, Merchant's Favor and Investments keep in memory, which can be over 10 MB once you've opened Make Money. Reopening those tabs works them out again in a moment, with the same results. Their lists also let go of what they last showed, which kept those results in memory even after they were released. Your started route and the assistant are kept as they are. WoW doesn't let an addon unload itself, so the addon can't go down to zero, but it now stays much lighter when you're not using it. (CurseForge)
- **Short of something an earlier step made? The route has you craft it again.** Some routes craft a material in one step and use it in a later one: Leatherworking cures Medium Hides to level and then uses those Cured Medium Hides for Hillman's Shoulders. With some luck in the first step you level with fewer crafts than expected and end up with fewer than the route counted on. The route then asked you to buy the missing ones ready-made on the AH, with no Medium Hide or Salt to make them. Now it asks for the materials (5 Medium Hide and 5 Salt) and adds a "Craft 5× Cured Medium Hide" row before the step that uses them. (CurseForge)
